title: Bottle Cleanup and Mountain Scene
tests: Separates an attached-photo edit from a new scene-generation request, completing both while retaining the reference product's identity.

faults.what: The white-background edit visibly re-renders the bottle instead of keeping it unchanged: stronger, smoother highlights make the original matte finish look satin/glossy, and the original surface details are altered.
The lake image simplifies the lid's carry-loop geometry and changes the bottle's proportions slightly compared with the source.

judge.summary: Two clean square images deliver the requested settings, but the white-background edit changes the bottle's finish rather than preserving it unchanged.

must_haves.item: Two separate square images are supplied, not a combined collage.
must_haves.why: Both outputs are separate square images.

must_haves.item: The first image retains the source bottle's silhouette, matte black finish and lid details against a plain white background.
must_haves.why: The white background and general silhouette are retained, but the finish is noticeably shinier and the bottle and lid details have been re-rendered.

must_haves.item: Neither the wooden table nor the original background remains in the first image.
must_haves.why: The table and room are completely replaced by white.

must_haves.item: The second image realistically shows the same bottle upright on a rock beside a mountain lake, with visible sunrise lighting.
must_haves.why: The recognizable black bottle stands upright on a foreground rock beside a mountain lake, with warm low-angle light on the mountains and reflections in the water.

must_haves.item: Neither image contains added text or logos.
must_haves.why: No text or logos are visible in either output.
